alter PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Loans_Retail]
AS
BEGIN



DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Loans_Retail_Random_Test;


WITH DimCustomerAccount_LNS AS
(
    SELECT
        DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1'
    GROUP BY DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate
)


SELECT 
    DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DB.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName AS ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ----,DP.FcbsApplication AS Application ----This column does not exist in DIM PRODUCT
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull * .85 as RelationshipExposure_Full
    ,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated * .85 as RelationshipExposure_Prorated
    ,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull * .85 as DueForTheMonth_Full
    ,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated * .85 as DueForTheMonth_Prorated
    ,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountFull * .85 as CreditLimit_Full
    ,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated * .85 as CreditLimit_Prorated
--    ,ABS(CHECKSUM(NewId())) % (SELECT AVG(TotalRelationshipExposureFull) FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure) AS RelationshipExposure_Full
--    ,ABS(CHECKSUM(NewId())) % (SELECT AVG(TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure) AS RelationshipExposure_Prorated
--    ,ABS(CHECKSUM(NewId())) % (SELECT AVG(OutstandingBalanceFull) FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance) AS DueForTheMonth_Full
--    ,ABS(CHECKSUM(NewId())) % (SELECT AVG(OutstandingBalanceProrated) FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance) AS DueForTheMonth_Prorated
--    ,ABS(CHECKSUM(NewId())) % (SELECT AVG(CreditLimitAmountFull) FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit) AS CreditLimit_Full
--    ,ABS(CHECKSUM(NewId())) % (SELECT AVG(CreditLimitAmountProrated) FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit) AS CreditLimit_Prorated
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,FLRE.BusinessDateSK)) AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DB.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode,Dp.ProductName) as AccountKey
    INTO DW.CI_Loans_Retail_Random_Test
FROM DimCustomerAccount_LNS DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Retail') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BankSK ,BankID FROM DW.DimBank) DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct) DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch) DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct) DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull ,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated ,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure )) FLRE ON DCA.AccountSK = FLRE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,OutstandingBalanceFull ,OutstandingBalanceProrated FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance )) FLOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FLOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,CreditLimitAmountFull ,CreditLimitAmountProrated FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansCreditLimit) ) FLCL ON DCA.AccountSK = FLCL.AccountSK ----NO DATA
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DB.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated
,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountFull
,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated
,FLRE.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate


END
